title: Shot plan
description: A list of shots for the video studio: each shot is one still image moved by one camera-motion sequence.
$comment: Rules JSON Schema cannot express, enforced by shotplan.py: (1) a shot's sequence is either inline ({segments}, fps taken from the plan) or a path to a sequence file relative to the plan file, whose fps must equal the plan's fps; it must pass camera_motion/sequences/validate.py and build without error, so presets exist and joins are continuous. (2) A shot's duration must equal its sequence's total duration (sum of segment duration_s) within half a frame. (3) Shot ids are unique. (4) transition is how a shot hands over to the NEXT shot: a crossfade of d seconds needs d > 0, d below both this shot's and the next shot's duration, and is not allowed on the last shot (which is always a cut). (5) Timeline: shot 0 starts at 0; each next shot starts at the previous end minus the crossfade. Shots never overlap beyond their crossfade. (6) image is a file path relative to the plan, or 'placeholder:<label>'.
